description: Foundation: disable the Cache Components build break, create the zustand cart store + provider, the shared site navbar/footer, shared product card and product grid, and rewire the (public) layout. Everything else depends on this. The repo currently FAILS `npm run build` because next.config.ts sets `cacheComponents: true`; with it on, every page that touches params/searchParams or uncached data breaks prerendering (and we may not edit admin pages). Turning it off is the one shared-config change required to ship a green build without rewriting admin.
steps: Modify c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\next.config.ts: change `cacheComponents: true` to `cacheComponents: false` and `partialPrefetching: true` to `partialPrefetching: false`. Leave the `images` config (domains + remotePatterns) and turbopack rules untouched.

Create c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\src\lib\cart-store.ts: zustand store with persist + createJSONStorage(localStorage), name 'furniture-cart', skipHydration:true. CartItem {id,name,price,image:string|null,qty,unit}. State {items, addItem(Omit<CartItem,'qty'>&{qty?}), removeItem(id), updateQty(id,qty) clamps Math.max(1,qty), clearCart()}. Export selectors selectTotalItems, selectTotalPrice and helper getDelivery(subtotal)= subtotal<=0?0:subtotal>=5000?0:60.
Create c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\src\components\cart-provider.tsx ('use client'): useEffect calls useCartStore.persist.rehydrate() once; returns <>{children}</>.

Create c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\src\components\site-navbar.tsx ('use client'): sticky top nav, logo ফার্নিচার স্টোর, links হোম/শপ/অর্ডার ট্র্যাক, search box that router.push(`/shop?search=...`), cart icon with badge from useCartStore(selectTotalItems) shown only when mounted&&count>0. Mobile menu uses the shadcn Sheet from @/components/ui/sheet controlled via open/onOpenChange; SheetContent side='left' with links that setOpen(false). Use usePathname to highlight active link.

Create c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\src\components\site-footer.tsx (server component): shop info, contact (ঢাকা, বাংলাদেশ / phone / email), quick links (সকল পণ্য→/shop, কার্ট→/cart, অর্ডার ট্র্যাক→/orders, অ্যাডমিন→/admin/login), copyright. Warm amber-900 footer.

Create c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\src\components\product-card.tsx ('use client'): props { product:{id,name,sellPrice,images:string[],stock,category?:{name,slug}} }. Render a card: next/image (or 🪑 emoji fallback in a bg-amber-50 box when images empty), name (line-clamp-2) linking to /product/[id], category name, price via formatCurrency, and কার্টে যোগ করুন button that calls useCartStore.addItem({id,name,price:sellPrice,image:images[0]??null,qty:1,unit:'PIECE'}) + toast.success, disabled when stock<=0 (label স্টক নেই).

Create c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\src\components\product-grid.tsx ('use client'): props { categorySlug?, fixedCategory?, initialSearch?, initialCategorySlug?, initialFeatured? }. State: page, sort(newest|price-asc|price-desc), selectedCategories[], minPrice, maxPrice, search (init from initialSearch). Fetch /api/categories/public once for the sidebar. Fetch /api/products/public?page=&limit=12&sort=&categorySlug=(fixedCategory?categorySlug:selectedCategories[0]||initialCategorySlug)&search=&featured=initialFeatured when deps change. Desktop sidebar (category checkboxes, price min/max inputs + range slider, clear-filters) and a mobile filter Sheet; sort dropdown (নতুন/দাম কম-বেশি/দাম বেশি-কম); grid of ProductCard; pagination prev/next + numbered with ellipsis; animate-pulse skeletons while loading; empty state 'কোনো পণ্য পাওয়া যায়নি'. When fixedCategory, hide the category filter (category is fixed).

Rewrite c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\src\app\(public)\layout.tsx (server component): wrap children as SessionProvider > CartProvider > <SiteNavbar/> + <main className="min-h-screen">{children}</main> + <SiteFooter/> + <Toaster position="top-right"/>. Import SiteNavbar/SiteFooter/CartProvider from @/components/*.
acceptance_criteria: next.config.ts has cacheComponents:false and partialPrefetching:false (images config unchanged).
src/lib/cart-store.ts exports useCartStore, selectTotalItems, selectTotalPrice, getDelivery and persists to localStorage key 'furniture-cart' with skipHydration:true.
src/app/(public)/layout.tsx renders SiteNavbar, SiteFooter, CartProvider, Toaster and no longer imports public-navbar/public-footer.
public-navbar.tsx and public-footer.tsx no longer exist.
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` in the repo root and confirm it exits 0.
Confirm `grep -r 'public-navbar\|public-footer' src` returns nothing (old files removed and no imports remain).
Note: do NOT expect `npm run build` to pass yet — the not-yet-rewritten shop/product/orders client pages still use useSearchParams/use(params) without Suspense and are rebuilt in FEAT-002..005.
findings:
FEAT-001 foundation complete. `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0. What later steps depend on:

- next.config.ts: cacheComponents:false + partialPrefetching:false (images config untouched). This is the single shared-config change that makes a green build possible WITHOUT rewriting admin; build stays red until FEAT-002..005 finish because the not-yet-rewritten client pages still use useSearchParams/use(params) without a Suspense boundary.

- Cart store (src/lib/cart-store.ts): `useCartStore` (zustand + persist + createJSONStorage(localStorage), key 'furniture-cart', skipHydration:true). State: items, addItem (increments qty if id exists, else qty??1), removeItem, updateQty (clamps Math.max(1,qty)), clearCart. CartItem = {id,name,price,image:string|null,qty,unit:string}. Exported selectors: selectTotalItems, selectTotalPrice (both return primitives -> no useShallow needed). Helper getDelivery(subtotal)= subtotal<=0?0:subtotal>=5000?0:60. Server renders an empty cart (no hydration mismatch) because skipHydration:true; CartProvider (src/components/cart-provider.tsx) calls useCartStore.persist.rehydrate() once on mount.

- ProductCard (src/components/product-card.tsx, 'use client') expects product shape {id,name,sellPrice,images:string[],stock,category?:{name,slug}} and exports `ProductCardProduct`. Add-to-cart hardcodes unit 'PIECE' and image = images[0]??null; button disabled when stock<=0 (label 'স্টক নেই'); uses next/image with fill + 🪑 emoji fallback. Server pages MUST cast Product.images (Json) to string[] (Array.isArray check) and map Product.category to {name,slug} before passing it in.

- ProductGrid (src/components/product-grid.tsx, 'use client') props: {categorySlug?, fixedCategory?, initialSearch?, initialCategorySlug?, initialFeatured?}. It self-fetches /api/products/public (page,limit=12,sort,categorySlug,search,featured) and /api/categories/public (sidebar). sort is newest|price-asc|price-desc. categorySlug sent to API = fixedCategory?categorySlug : selectedCategories[0]||initialCategorySlug. Price filter is CLIENT-side (the public API has no price filter), so it only filters the current page. When fixedCategory, the category filter block is hidden. It keeps `search` in sync with the initialSearch prop (so navbar search -> /shop?search= updates it). Mobile filter uses the shadcn Sheet.

- Sheet = Base UI Dialog (@/components/ui/sheet), controlled via `open` + `onOpenChange(open,eventDetails)`; SheetContent takes `side`. Used by SiteNavbar (left mobile menu) and ProductGrid (left mobile filter).

- SiteNavbar logo text 'ফার্নিচার স্টোর'; links হোম/শপ/অর্ডার ট্র্যাক; search -> router.push('/shop?search=...'); cart badge is mounted-guarded (shows only when mounted && totalItems>0). SiteFooter is a server component (uses next/link). Both replace the deleted public-navbar.tsx / public-footer.tsx (no references remain).

- (public)/layout.tsx is a server component wrapping: SessionProvider > CartProvider > SiteNavbar + main.min-h-screen + SiteFooter + Toaster(position='top-right'). Root src/app/layout.tsx is untouched.

- Conventions for later pages: Bengali labels; warm amber palette (bg-amber-50/100, amber-600/700/800/900, orange-50/600, text gray-700/800); cards bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-amber-100; skeletons animate-pulse; truncate line-clamp-2; prices via formatCurrency from @/lib/utils; toasts via react-hot-toast; server pages set export const dynamic='force-dynamic' and call prisma directly via @/lib/prisma (not the public API).
